criteria.name: correct-severity
criteria.anchor: 1.0: medium or low. 0.5: high. 0.0: critical or informational.

criteria.name: actionable-fix
criteria.anchor: 1.0: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare with a note on equal length or hashing. 0.5: says use constant-time compare without detail. 0.0: none.

expected_outcomes: Finds the non-constant-time comparison of the bearer token (!= on strings), which can leak the secret through response timing
Rates it medium or low (network timing attacks are hard in practice) and does not call it critical
Recommends crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare over equal-length inputs, for example comparing SHA-256 digests of both values
Does not flag crypto/rand generation, the 32-byte length or base64url encoding as weak
